settings.question: How much does a stamped concrete patio cost?
settings.answer: Stamped and decorative work costs more than a plain broom finish because of the color, stamping and sealing labor. Size, pattern and site prep all affect the price — use our estimator for a ballpark, then we confirm with a free on-site visit in Orem, Provo, Pleasant Grove and nearby.

settings.question: What stamp patterns and colors can I choose?
settings.answer: We offer stone, slate, cobblestone, brick and wood-plank patterns in a wide range of integral colors and stains. We'll walk you through samples during the design step so it matches your home.

settings.question: Does stamped concrete hold up in Utah?
settings.answer: Yes — when it's based, reinforced, sloped and sealed correctly. We seal every decorative pour and recommend resealing every few years to keep color rich and protect against freeze-thaw and UV fade.

settings.question: Is stamped concrete cheaper than pavers or natural stone?
settings.answer: In most cases, yes. Stamped concrete gives you the look of premium stone or brick with one continuous, low-maintenance surface and no shifting joints — usually at a lower installed cost.
